ex.zh: 地球磁場是由地球外核熔融的流動週期造成。

ex.en: He's willing to do low-paid manual jobs.
ex.zh: 他願做低薪資體力勞動的工作。

ex.en: This car was designed and manufactured in Italy.
ex.zh: 這輛車在義大利設計製造。

ex.en: A marathon runner has to be able to keep running for 42.195 kilometers, without any intermediate supply of water and food.
ex.zh: 一位馬拉松跑者要能連續跑 42.195 公里，期間接受最少量的食物和水供應。

senses.zh: 邊界,邊緣,留好空白以容納註記

ex.en: Use double spacing and wide margins to leave room for comments.
ex.zh: 隔行，留寬邊，才好留空白寫註記。

ex.en: He has made measurable improvements in his English.
ex.zh: 他的英文有明顯的進步。

ex.en: Any mechanic will have this problem.
ex.zh: 任何一個技工都會碰到這種問題。

ex.en: Any machine will have an emergency landing due to mechanical problems.
ex.zh: 由於機械問題，飛機必須安全降落。

ex.en: The service is a memorial to those killed in the war.
ex.zh: 此儀式是為了紀念戰事中犧牲的人。

ex.en: The boy was screaming and begging for mercy.
ex.zh: 男孩尖叫乞求憐憫。

ex.en: They have deep respect for a greater zwaugd.
ex.zh: 這種嚴肅的討論得到更大的讚賞。
